scope.flow: executeHedge with PM active registers a spot token in vaultSupplied without a BLP reserve, then accounting reads revert
scope.environment: MonetrixVault/MonetrixAccountant on HyperEVM with HyperLiquid PM and 0x811 precompile

entities.name: Spot asset token without BLP reserve

statements.text: executeHedge() is called with PM active.
No BLP reserve exists for the spot token bought by executeHedge.
executeHedge() buys the spot asset on L1 and registers it in the accountant's vaultSupplied registry via notifyVaultSupply.

The vaultSupplied registration is unconditional with no check that BLP has an active reserve for the token, so the EVM state records the token as supplied even though L1 auto-supply silently did nothing.
Querying 0x811 for the never-supplied token produces a failure response, causing suppliedBalance() to revert.
The revert propagates so totalBackingSigned(), surplus(), distributableSurplus() and settleDailyPnL gate 3 all revert.
Every accounting read and yield settlement call is permanently bricked until an operator calls removeSuppliedEntry to remove the bad registry entry.
A token should be registered in vaultSupplied only if BLP actually has an active reserve for it, so that backing reads over vaultSupplied do not revert.

ambiguities: Report does not state who may call executeHedge or whether the caller is authorized.
Report does not establish the token's prior state or that executeHedge was actually invoked in a real transaction; scenario is conditional on PM active and no BLP reserve.
Report does not specify the exact failure response or revert condition enforced by suppliedBalance beyond a hard requirement on the 0x811 response.
